title: Gamified joint-attention task (GS): an iPad app for automated assessment of response to joint attention
description:
An iPad app (Expo / React Native, TypeScript) that measures preschool children's response to joint attention (RJA) automatically. A child-like virtual character directs the child to one of two or four identical objects with escalating cues (gaze, head turn, pointing, highlighting); trials are scored by the cue level needed, difficulty adapts, and every touch, selection and drag is logged on the device and exported as JSON.

Licences: source code MIT; object and room images CC BY 4.0; the video clips are included so the task runs as published but are not openly licensed (see assets/README.md). Export format: docs/DATA.md.
